name: A long turn done says it went well, and a very long one is celebrated
judge: A three-minute turn ends well, a solid win but not a big one. Then a twenty-minute turn ends well, and that one should stand out.
reasonable: A pleased success at the first with a word, mood calm or a little glad. A clearly larger success at the second, proud, happy or excited, its mood lifting.
unreasonable: A failure at either, a huge moment at the short one and less at the long one, or no reaction at the twenty-minute finish.

steps.message: All tests pass, and I pushed the branch.
